sources.title: qwen3-vl-flash model information
sources.evidence: Complete indexed model-card text identifies the hosted alias, thinking/non-thinking modes, text/image/video input, text output and 262144-token context. It compares Flash with open-source Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B without identifying Flash's parameter counts or architecture. Direct opening exceeded the browser tool's content-size limit; these are last documented specifications, not a live API test.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Live lifecycle table lists qwen3-vl-flash and its 2025-10-15 snapshot as released in Beijing on 2025-10-14, then internationally on 2025-10-15. The row describes visual reasoning, image/video understanding and long documents.

sources.title: qwen3-vl-flash regional capabilities
sources.evidence: Indexed exact-model card shows regional capability tables: Beijing supports Function Calling; Singapore, Frankfurt and Virginia show it unsupported. The January 2026 snapshot table also marks it unsupported. Direct opening exceeded the browser tool's content-size limit.

sources.title: Update Notice for Qwen3-VL-Flash Models
sources.evidence: March 19, 2026 notice schedules the Beijing and Singapore alias upgrade from qwen3-vl-flash-2025-10-15 to qwen3-vl-flash-2026-01-22 for March 24, 2026. Establishes that this is a rolling hosted alias.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL official repository
sources.evidence: Names the developer and enumerates released open checkpoints. No Flash checkpoint or exact mapping to one is documented. The repository's Apache-2.0 license and dense/MoE configurations cannot be transferred to the hosted Flash alias.

sources.title: Function Calling
sources.evidence: Supported-model list includes Qwen3-VL-Flash series separately from the Qwen3-VL open-source series. Supports tool capability at family level but does not override regional model-card restrictions.

sources.title: Building AI Products with Qwen
sources.evidence: Indexed official API landing page names Qwen3-VL-Flash and text/image/video inputs with text output, but lists 131027 context length. This conflicts with the exact Alibaba Cloud Model Studio card's 262144; the service-specific card is used for this Alibaba Cloud record.

sources.title: Models.dev original qwen3-vl-flash record
sources.evidence: Original catalog source was inspected as a lead. It records October 15 and open_weights=false; it does not independently establish weights availability or first regional release.

name.note: Readable display name for the exact qwen3-vl-flash hosted identifier.

release_date.note: Earliest documented availability is Beijing on October 14; October 15 is the international/global launch and original snapshot suffix.

open_weights.note: Primary materials document a hosted alias distinct from the open-source checkpoints, with no Flash weight download. They do not explicitly establish non-release. No verified exact weight release or explicit closed-weight statement; clear the unsupported baseline boolean.

license.note: No exact-model weight license is stated; the open repository's Apache-2.0 license is not evidence for Flash.

parameters_b.note: No total count disclosed. Comparison with 30B-A3B is not identity.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count disclosed; do not borrow 3B from the comparator.

architecture.note: No exact hosted-model topology disclosed; dense versus MoE remains unknown.

context_window.note: Exact Model Studio limit; conflicting Qwen API landing-page value is recorded in s7.

reasoning.note: Thinking mode is explicitly supported alongside non-thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Verified for Beijing only. Regional card says unsupported in Singapore, Frankfurt and Virginia; this boolean must not imply universal deployment support.

description.value: Alibaba Cloud hosted Qwen3-VL model for image, video and document understanding, with optional thinking mode.
description.note: Replaces broad agent-task phrasing with directly documented capabilities.

patch.description: Alibaba Cloud hosted Qwen3-VL model for image, video and document understanding, with optional thinking mode.
patch.notes: Hosted rolling alias; total/active parameter counts and dense/MoE architecture are undisclosed. Do not identify it with Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B. Last documented model-card specifications are available through the search index; the public help card now redirects and the console mirror exceeds the reader limit. Function calling is documented for Beijing but unsupported in Singapore, Frankfurt and Virginia. Beijing availability began 2025-10-14; international/global availability began 2025-10-15. The March 2026 notice schedules the Beijing/Singapore alias upgrade to the 2026-01-22 snapshot. Current endpoint availability was not tested.

summary: Correct release to first Beijing availability on 2025-10-14, add Qwen3-VL family and video input, enable reasoning, and narrow the description. Retain 262144 context and tool_call=true with an explicit Beijing-only qualification. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed. Exact-model weight release status was not independently established. Sources support last documented specifications, not a current availability claim.
